column1: # swi_tests -- the shipped .pl files that declare NO plunit unit: they are the vendor's drivers, helpers, data and
# library modules that the test files load, never test programs. Every .pl that declares a begin_tests( unit is graded
# per case by scripts/test_prolog_swi_suite.sh against the .ref beside it (cut by scripts/util_swi_cut_refs.sh from
# swipl 9.0.4). One row per file: path<TAB>CLASS<TAB>reason. Lon 2026-09-12: "Get all SWI tests graded."
